segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily t-zone skin report the product melts sebum and reduces congestion around the nose, with several noting a smoother, less oily-looking finish afterward.
segments.dry: Reviewers who applied it on dry skin (as instructed) generally report a soft, smooth, non-tight finish, though one reviewer with dry skin felt the cleanser made no difference to pores and another noted tightness and dryness after rinsing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, especially those with an oily nose/t-zone, describe visibly smaller pores and reduced oiliness in those zones.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers consistently report no irritation and good tolerance, with some specifically praising it as gentle and non-reactive.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically identify mature skin.

concerns.aging: No reviewers frame their experience around aging or fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say skin feels soft, smooth, and not tight or stripped after rinsing; a minority report a tight, dry feeling post-rinse.
concerns.redness: One reviewer specifically noted reduced redness after use; this is not widely discussed elsewhere.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers largely describe the cleanser as non-stripping and gentle, preserving the skin's natural oils rather than disrupting the barrier.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers with blackheads/whiteheads on the nose report visible reduction or removal after use, though a few say blackheads remained visible or unchanged.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who mention acne-prone skin report clearer, smoother-looking skin after continued use, with no reports of new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin and combination reviewers frequently note reduced surface oil and a less greasy feel, though one reviewer called it simply 'an oily cleanser' that didn't deep-clean as expected.
